map.基于 Mifflin-St Jeor 公式计算基础代谢与每日总消耗（TDEE），: Computes basal metabolic rate and daily total expenditure (TDEE) with the Mifflin-St Jeor formula, plans the daily energy deficit and intake needed to reach a target weight, and outputs a weekly weight loss trajectory.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：(w-target)×7700；dailyDefic: Core formulas (by input variable): (w−target)×7700; dailyDeficit×7÷7700; weeks×7
map.自定义 TDEE（选填，>0 时覆盖计算值）: Custom TDEE (optional; overrides the calculated value when greater than 0)
💡 BMR (Mifflin): male = 10W+6.25H−5A+5, female = 10W+6.25H−5A−161; 1 kg of fat ≈ 7700 kcal; safe weight loss is 0.5 to 1 kg per week.
map.每日摄入不应低于 BMR，长期低于基础代谢损害健康: Daily intake should never fall below BMR, since staying below basal metabolic rate long term harms health
map.建议每周减重 0.5–1kg，过快减重易流失肌肉与反弹: Losing 0.5 to 1 kg per week is recommended, because faster loss tends to lose muscle and rebound
map.实际减重受饮食结构、运动、睡眠、激素等影响: Actual weight loss is also affected by diet structure, exercise, sleep and hormones
map.本工具为估算，不替代专业营养师或医师建议: This tool gives estimates and does not replace advice from a professional nutritionist or physician
map.📚 深度解析：减重能量缺口计算（周轨迹）: 📚 Deep Dive: Weight Loss Energy Deficit Calculator (Weekly Trajectory)
map.设定目标体重，算每日缺口与预计达成周数: Set a target weight and compute the daily deficit and the estimated weeks to reach it
map.用 7700 kcal≈1kg 脂肪把缺口转成周减重: Convert the deficit into weekly loss using 7700 kcal ≈ 1 kg of fat
map.判定缺口是否安全（0.5–1kg/周 为宜）: Judge whether the deficit is safe (0.5 to 1 kg per week is preferable)
map.2400、每日缺口 500 kcal → 周减重 = 500×7/7700 ≈: At 2400 kcal with a daily deficit of 500 kcal, the weekly loss = 500×7/7700 ≈ 0.45 kg per week; losing 7 kg takes about 15 to 16 weeks, while a deficit of 1000 gives about 0.91 kg per week, close to the upper limit.
map.缺口 1200 kcal/天 → 周减 1200×7/7700 ≈ 1.09 k: A deficit of 1200 kcal per day gives a weekly loss of 1200×7/7700 ≈ 1.09 kg, and exceeding 1 kg per week risks losing muscle and rebounding, so the deficit should be reduced to 500 to 750 kcal per day.
map.约等于 1kg 体脂能量，实际含水分/肌肉变动；只作规划近似，真实减重前快后慢。: It is roughly the energy in 1 kg of body fat, but actual weight change also involves water and muscle, so treat it as a planning approximation. Real weight loss tends to be fast at first and slower later.
map.不是，>1kg/周 多减水分肌肉、易反弹；0.5–1kg/周 更能保肌肉、可持续: No. More than 1 kg per week mostly loses water and muscle and rebounds. A rate of 0.5 to 1 kg per week preserves muscle better and is sustainable.
